image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a wet, textured rocky surface. The chiton has an oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a rough, granular girdle. The plates are dark green/grey with visible growth lines. Surrounding the chiton are small pebbles, barnacles, and other marine debris on the rock.
